title: Pre-release predictions of Gaia DR4 astrometric signals from known outer companions to transiting giant planets: code and data
description:
Code, input table and per-draw results behind the pre-registered predictions in the Research Note "Pre-release Predictions of Gaia DR4 Astrometric Signals from Known Outer Companions to Transiting Giant Planets" (J. McBee). The predictions were fixed before the Gaia DR4 release on 2 December 2026.

Key files: results/known_companion_predictions.csv (input table and detection probabilities), scripts/known_companion_predictions.py (simulation), scripts/plot_known_companion_predictions.py and figures/known_companion_predictions_fig1.pdf (figure), paper/known_companion_predictions.tex and .bib (the note), results/completeness.csv (injection-recovery calibration).
